connector.name: Sagemath MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server wrapping SageMath's full computer algebra system - 10 symbolic-math tools for LLMs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sagemath-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the justice8096 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SAGE_TIMEOUT
env.description: Per-call SageMath timeout in milliseconds. Default 30000.

env.name: SAGE_DOCKER_IMAGE
env.description: Docker image used when SageMath is not installed locally. Default sagemath/sagemath:latest.

env.name: API_KEY
env.description: If set, HTTP transport requires matching API_KEY header. Ignored for stdio.
